title: What If Megalodon Never Went Extinct?

scenes.text: What if megalodon never died out? The great white would be the small shark.
It grew around 15 meters long, roughly three times the length of a great white shark.
Its teeth reached 18 centimeters, and its bite is estimated at up to 41,000 pounds of force.
Fossil whale bones carry its tooth marks and broken tooth tips, so whales were on the menu.
It vanished about 3.6 million years ago, and a changing climate likely played a part.
Today nothing in the sea comes close. Its bite may have been up to ten times a great white's.

description:
What if megalodon still swam in our oceans?
It grew about 15 meters long, with 18 centimeter teeth, and may have bitten up to ten times harder than a great white.
